note: Fastly Purger is a submodule of fastly that integrates with the contrib Purge module. It provides a Purge purger plugin (id 'fastly', types tag/url/everything, multi_instance FALSE, class FastlyPurger routing to fastly.api), a Purge diagnostic check 'fastly_creds' (CredentialCheck, dependent_purger_plugins {fastly}), and a service provider that clears the cache_tags_invalidator tag from fastly.cache_tags.invalidator. It has no config of its own; Fastly credentials come from the parent module and the purger is registered in the Purge module's purge.plugins:purgers list. Actual purging needs real Fastly credentials, so medium/hard cases are grounded ONLY in the local purge.plugins purger registration, never in live API calls.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal fastlypurger submodule add, and what invalidation types does its Purge purger support?
evals.expected_output: It adds a Purge purger plugin with id 'fastly' (label Fastly) that supports the invalidation types tag, url and everything, routing each to the fastly.api purge calls.

evals.prompt: Besides the purger, what Purge diagnostic check does fastlypurger provide and what does it check?
evals.expected_output: It provides the Purge diagnostic check 'fastly_creds' (CredentialCheck), which warns in Purge's status report when the configured Fastly API credentials are missing or invalid.

evals.prompt: Which modules does fastlypurger depend on, and how do you add the Fastly purger to the Purge configuration from the command line?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the fastly and purge modules. Add the purger with drush p:purger-add fastly (or via the Purge UI). Purgers are stored in purge.plugins:purgers.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the Purge module's configuration and state whether the Fastly purger is currently registered as a purger.
evals.expected_output: Yes — purge.plugins:purgers contains an entry whose plugin_id is 'fastly' (the Fastly purger is registered).

evals.prompt: The Fastly purger is registered in the Purge module on this site. Inspect the running site and report which invalidation types that Fastly purger can handle.
evals.expected_output: The registered fastly purger supports tag, url and everything invalidation types (from its plugin definition / drush p:purger-ls + plugin info).

evals.prompt: On this site, register the Fastly purger with the Purge module so that Fastly can be purged through Purge. Apply the change to the live configuration. (Do not attempt a live purge against the Fastly API.)
evals.expected_output: purge.plugins:purgers gains an entry with plugin_id 'fastly' (e.g. drush p:purger-add fastly, or edit the purge.plugins config).

evals.prompt: This site currently has the Fastly purger registered in the Purge module. Remove/unregister the Fastly purger from Purge and apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: purge.plugins:purgers no longer contains any entry with plugin_id 'fastly' (e.g. drush p:purger-rm <instance_id>).
